{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Youmay|the astronomical objects|the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] known as "[[Comet (clone trooper)/Legends|Comet]]"}}
[[File:AbafarComets-ASDitV.png|thumb|right|250px|The comet field around [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]]]]
'''Comets''' were balls of [[Water/Legends|ice]] and rock floating through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and sometimes [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Star/Legends|stars]]. Class five was a class of comets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Koros-Strohna|worldships]] could be mistaken for comets when seen through [[Telescope/Legends|telescopes]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>
